title: napRider-napoli97
summary: Isometric 1997 Naples myth-adventure in a white 1971 Fiat 500 L.
description: An unofficial PRG32 arcade adventure set in Naples in 1997. Drive a recognizable white 1971 Fiat 500 L through byte-coded isometric districts with coherent roads, crossings, buildings, seafronts, parks and underground corridors; follow fictional Virgilian signs, evade scooter gangs, and descend into Napoli Sotterranea for a final encounter with the legendary Egg of Virgil.
